proxy_reward_note: Agents are NOT trained on the satisfaction term directly. DDPG uses a deterministic policy — exploration relies on action noise added only during training.

ddpg_specific_notes.policy: Deterministic — noise added at train time, NOT at eval time
ddpg_specific_notes.exploration_noise: OrnsteinUhlenbeck or Normal — sampled per HPs Optuna trial
ddpg_specific_notes.no_ent_coef: DDPG has no entropy regularisation term
ddpg_specific_notes.first_evaluation: DDPG had no results in the original EV2Gym paper. This is the first evaluation on this benchmark.

vecnorm_freeze: VecNormalize stats frozen after training (training=False, norm_reward=False) before ALL evaluation episodes.
optuna_asymmetry_note: F2 searches same 30 trials as F1 but across 3 additional YAML dims. F2 HPs may be less well-tuned per dimension.
mpc_horizon_note: EV2Gym paper MPC uses horizon=25 steps (Table VII). Our reproduced variant could not match that config — treated as a distinct controller.
paper_ref_note: DDPG evaluated in EV2Gym Table VII WITHOUT HPO (default SB3). Our framework adds two-phase Optuna HPO — improvement over these values shows the contribution of systematic tuning.
single_scenario_note: All results are from the workplace scenario only.
statistical_note: High std relative to mean expected in Phase 2. Pairwise differences may not be statistically significant without bootstrap CIs / Wilcoxon tests.
